LESSON: SIGN READING 7.2.3 WORD FORMATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Sign Reading 7.2.3 Word formation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 7.2.3 Word formation, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we read words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 7.2.3 Word formation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: interpretation and inference skills as learner reasons out joining of syllables and letter

sounds to form 3 letter words.

● Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology skills as learner play digital games in forming three letter words.

Values:
● Integrity: honesty as learner independently forms 3 letter words.

● Patriotism: citizenship as learner begin to appreciate rivers, oceans and lakes as natural resources within the country.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health related issues awareness as learner learns to avoid drinking contaminated water to avoid illnesses.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Word formation is a necessary skill in all activity areas as it is a prerequisite for reading.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures, word bank,

online resources, relevant digital devices.
